## Outcome

Story / bug ID and link:

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Include a before/after example if useful.

## Scope and decisions

State relevant ADRs, alternatives or limitations. Include migration, compatibility and rollback implications when applicable.

## Acceptance and evidence

- [ ] Acceptance criteria are covered; story status is accurate.
- [ ] Relevant domain/integration tests added or updated.
- [ ] Lint, typecheck, docs checks, full database-backed tests and build pass.
- [ ] UI changes checked on desktop/mobile and with keyboard; attach non-sensitive evidence.
- [ ] Ownership, validation, concurrency and timezone effects reviewed.
- [ ] Relevant NFR IDs and evidence/gaps updated.
- [ ] Docs, diagrams and changelog reflect final behavior.
- [ ] No secrets or personal datasets included.

List commands/results or CI links. Explain any unchecked item; don't claim unperformed checks.
